decisions.reason: As a flagship biodynamic yogurt line in the firm's core organic dairy range that remained featured after launch, it is very likely to stay in the assortment.
This mild sliced cheese is a close extension of the firm's established cheese business and its dedicated product page suggests normal ongoing support rather than a short test.
The sliced butter cheese also fits the firm's core dairy competence and customer base, though as a newer line extension it carries a slightly higher pruning risk than the flagship yogurt.
